\func get-leaf-less-lemma (l r : GroupTerm V) (ind : Nat) (p : ind < suc (count-leaves l)) : get-leaf (l :* r) ind = get-leaf l ind
\func get-leaf-zro-leaves-lemma (t : GroupTerm V) (p : count-leaves t = 0) (nf-pf : isInNF t) : interpret t = ide

\func rp-preserves-nf (t : GroupTerm V) (nf-pf : isInNF t) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) : isInNF (remove-pair t fstLeafToRemoveInd).1
\func rp-count-leaves-lemma (t : GroupTerm V) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) : count-leaves (remove-pair t fstLeafToRemoveInd).1 <= count-leaves t

\func rp-correctness-both-inside (t : GroupTerm V) (nf-pf : isInNF t) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) (p : interpret (get-leaf t fstLeafToRemoveInd) = inverse (interpret $ get-leaf t (suc fstLeafToRemoveInd))) (lb : 1 <= fstLeafToRemoveInd) (ub : fstLeafToRemoveInd < count-leaves t) : interpret (remove-pair t fstLeafToRemoveInd).1 = interpret t
\func rp-correctness-one-inside-left (t : GroupTerm V) (nf-pf : isInNF t) : interpret t = interpret (get-leaf t 1) * interpret (remove-pair t 0).1
\func rp-correctness-one-inside-right (t : GroupTerm V) (nf-pf : isInNF t) : interpret t = interpret (remove-pair t (count-leaves t)).1 * interpret (get-leaf t (count-leaves t))

\func rp-returns-true-lemma (t : GroupTerm V) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) (p : (remove-pair t fstLeafToRemoveInd).2 = true) (lb : 1 <= {NatSemiring} fstLeafToRemoveInd) (ub : fstLeafToRemoveInd < count-leaves t) : interpret t = (interpret $ get-leaf t fstLeafToRemoveInd) * (interpret $ get-leaf t (suc fstLeafToRemoveInd))
\func rp-returns-true-lemma-left (t : GroupTerm V) (p : (remove-pair t 0).2 = true) : \Sigma (interpret t = (interpret $ get-leaf t 1)) (interpret (remove-pair t 0).1 = ide)

\func rp-returns-true-lemma-right (t : GroupTerm V) (p : (remove-pair t (count-leaves t)).2 = true) : \Sigma (interpret t = (interpret $ get-leaf t (count-leaves t))) (interpret (remove-pair t (count-leaves t)).1 = ide)

\func rp-returns-true-lemma' (l r : GroupTerm V) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) (p : (remove-pair (l :* r) fstLeafToRemoveInd).2 = true) : \Sigma (l' r' : Leaf) (l = Leaf.leaf-to-term l') (r = Leaf.leaf-to-term r')
\func rp-returns-true-lemma'' (t : GroupTerm V) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) : (remove-pair t fstLeafToRemoveInd).2 = true -> count-leaves t >= 1

\func rp-returns-true-lemma''' (l r : GroupTerm V) (fstLeafToRemoveInd : Nat) : (remove-pair (l :* r) fstLeafToRemoveInd).2 = true -> \Sigma ((remove-pair l fstLeafToRemoveInd).2 = true) ((remove-pair r 0).2 = true) (fstLeafToRemoveInd = count-leaves l)
\func find-fstLeafToRemoveInd (t : GroupTerm V) : Maybe (\Sigma (ind : Nat) (interpret (get-leaf t ind) = inverse (interpret (get-leaf t (suc ind)))) (1 <= ind) (ind < count-leaves t))

\func find-fstLeafToRemoveInd-rec (t : GroupTerm V) (ind : Nat) : Maybe (\Sigma (ind' : Nat) (interpret (get-leaf t ind') = inverse (interpret (get-leaf t (suc ind')))) (1 <= ind') (ind' < count-leaves t))
\func leaf-isInv-lemma (l l' : Leaf) (p : Leaf.isInv l = not (Leaf.isInv l')) (q : Leaf.val l = Leaf.val l') : interpret (Leaf.leaf-to-term l) = inverse (interpret (Leaf.leaf-to-term l'))
\func find-pair-to-remove (t : GroupTerm V) (lastVisitedLeaf : Maybe Leaf) : \Sigma Nat (Maybe Leaf) Bool
\func simplify (t : GroupTerm V) : GroupTerm V
\func simplify-correct (t : GroupTerm V) : interpret t = interpret (simplify t)
\class CGroupData \extends NatData { \override G : CGroup }
\func removeVar (n : Nat) (t : GroupTerm Nat) (v : Nat) (withInv : Bool) : \Sigma (GroupTerm Nat) Nat

\lemma removeVar-lem (t : GroupTerm V) (v : V) (withInv : Bool) {n : Nat} : \Sigma (interpret (removeVar n t v withInv).1 * G.pow (if withInv (inverse (f v)) (f v)) (n ∧ countVar t v withInv) = interpret t) ((removeVar n t v withInv).2 = n -' countVar t v withInv)
\lemma pow-lem {b : Bool} {n : Nat} {x : G} : G.pow (if b (inverse x) x) n = inverse (G.pow (if (not b) (inverse x) x) n)
\lemma sum-lem {a b c : Nat} : a ∧ (b + c) = a ∧ b + (a -' b) ∧ c

\lemma removeVar_<=-lem (t : GroupTerm V) (v : V) (withInv : Bool) {n : Nat} (p : n <= countVar t v withInv) : interpret (removeVar n t v withInv).1 * G.pow (if withInv (inverse (f v)) (f v)) n = interpret t
\lemma removeVar-correct (t : GroupTerm V) (v : V) (n : Nat) (p : n <= countVar t v false) (q : n <= countVar t v true) : interpret (removeVar n (removeVar n t v true).1 v false).1 = interpret t
\func countVar (t : GroupTerm Nat) (v : Nat) (withInv : Bool) : Nat
\func toList (t : GroupTerm Nat) (withInv : Bool) : List (\Sigma Nat Bool)
\func countVars (l : List (\Sigma (\Sigma Nat Bool) Nat)) : List (\Sigma Nat Nat)
\func removeVars (t : GroupTerm Nat) (l : List (\Sigma Nat Nat)) : GroupTerm Nat
\func simplify (t : GroupTerm Nat)

\lemma removeVars-correct (t : GroupTerm V) {l : List (\Sigma V Nat)} (a : All (\lam p => \Sigma (p.2 <= countVar t p.1 false) (p.2 <= countVar t p.1 true)) l) (b : All2 (__.1 /= __.1) l) : interpret (removeVars t l) = interpret t
\lemma count-removeVar-lem {t : GroupTerm V} {u v : V} {w w' : Bool} {n : Nat} (p : u /= v) : countVar (removeVar n t v w').1 u w = countVar t u w
\lemma count-removeVars-lem {t : GroupTerm V} {l : List (\Sigma V Nat)} {v : V} {withInv : Bool} (a : All (v /= __.1) l) : countVar (removeVars t l) v withInv = countVar t v withInv
\lemma toList-correct (t : GroupTerm Nat) (p : \Sigma Nat Bool) (b : Bool) : count (toList t b) p = countVar t p.1 (if b (not p.2) p.2)
\lemma group-correct (t : GroupTerm Nat) : All (\lam p => p.2 <= countVar t p.1.1 p.1.2) $ group $ Insertion.sort $ toList t false

\lemma countVars-correct (t : GroupTerm Nat) {l : List (\Sigma (\Sigma Nat Bool) Nat)} (a : All (\lam p => p.2 <= countVar t p.1.1 p.1.2) l) (a' : AllC (\lam p1 p2 => p1.1.1 = p2.1.1 -> \Sigma (p1.1.2 = false) (p2.1.2 = true)) l) : All (\lam p => \Sigma (p.2 <= countVar t p.1 false) (p.2 <= countVar t p.1 true)) (countVars l)
\lemma countVars-ineq {l : List (\Sigma (\Sigma Nat Bool) Nat)} {x : Nat} (a : All (x /= __.1.1) l) : All (x /= __.1) (countVars l)

\lemma countVars-diff {l : List (\Sigma (\Sigma Nat Bool) Nat)} (a' : AllC (\lam p1 p2 => p1.1.1 = p2.1.1 -> \Sigma (p1.1.2 = false) (p2.1.2 = true)) l) (a : All2 (__.1 /= __.1) l) : All2 (__.1 /= __.1) (countVars l)

\lemma sort-correct-lem {l : List (\Sigma (\Sigma Nat Bool) Nat)} (s : Sorted (map __.1 l)) (a : All2 (__.1 /= __.1) l) : AllC (\lam p1 p2 => p1.1.1 = p2.1.1 -> \Sigma (p1.1.2 = false) (p2.1.2 = true)) l
\lemma sort-correct {l : List (\Sigma Nat Bool)} : AllC (\lam p1 p2 => p1.1.1 = p2.1.1 -> \Sigma (p1.1.2 = false) (p2.1.2 = true)) $ group $ Insertion.sort l
\lemma count-remove-lem {t : GroupTerm Nat} {v v' : Nat} (withInv : Bool) {n : Nat} : countVar (removeVar n t v' (not withInv)).1 v withInv = countVar t v withInv
\lemma simplify-correct (t : GroupTerm V) : interpret t = interpret (simplify t)
